author: claude-opus-5-5
comparison: Rejected drawing was a single bust with a flat hat band; the son, half of the original's subject, was missing.
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px light/dark. Two kufi-wearing busts, the father taller on the right and the son shorter on the left; reads as father and son at 48.
omissions: Father's arm and robe seams (no 8-unit room between the bodies); the son stands beside rather than overlapping the father.
human_reference: icon_set/references/human_ref/user.svg; each jaw touches its own shoulder arch 4 below on a shared axis (x=36 father, x=12 son).
